Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2026

TL;DR

We don't collect, store, or transmit your resume data. All processing happens locally in your browser. We don't have user accounts or databases of resume content.

1. Data Processing

Online Resume ATS processes all resume data, job descriptions, and generated content entirely within your web browser. No personal data from your resume is transmitted to our servers or any third-party service.

2. What We Don't Collect

  • Resume content or text
  • Job descriptions you paste
  • Generated cover letters
  • Personal information (name, email, phone from your resume)
  • Uploaded PDF files

3. What We May Collect

For basic site analytics and improvement, we may collect:

  • Anonymous page view counts
  • Browser type and general location (country level)
  • Which tools are used (not what content is processed)

4. Cookies

We use cookies for basic site functionality, analytics (Google Analytics), and advertising (Google AdSense). These third-party services may set cookies to measure traffic and serve relevant ads. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

5. Third-Party Services

We use Google Analytics (GA4) for anonymous traffic analytics and Google AdSense for advertising. These services may collect anonymized data according to their own privacy policies. We do not sell or share personal data with data brokers.

6. PDF Processing

When you upload a PDF, it is processed using pdf.js (Mozilla's open-source library) directly in your browser. The file is read into memory, parsed, and text is extracted — all on your device. The file is never uploaded to any server.

7. Children's Privacy

Our service is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated date.

9. Contact

If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at our contact page.
